title: Group Fairness Meets the Black Box: Enabling Fair Algorithms on Closed LLMs via Post-Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Statistical Parity, True Positive Rate Parity, and Equalized Odds on the Adult (income prediction) and BiasBios (occupation prediction) datasets by extracting LLM probabilistic predictions and applying post-hoc fair classification algorithms.

Evaluating Statistical Parity, False Positive Rate Parity, and Equalized Odds on the ACSIncome (income prediction) and COMPAS (recidivism prediction) datasets by extracting LLM probabilistic predictions and applying post-hoc fair classification algorithms.

Evaluating False Positive Rate (FPR) parity on the CivilComments dataset for toxicity detection across overlapping religious groups (Christianity, Judaism, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism) using LLM-extracted features and post-hoc fair classification algorithms.
